applicability: The 'On this page' aside on a wide screen.
conditions: It lists the text's chapters and the record sections with their counts and marks the current chapter.
Cited code takes its place while it is open.
statement: On this page lists rendered chapters and record sections, marks the current chapter and yields its pane to cited code.
